title: SAP B1 Technical Consultant
description:
We are seeking a skilled SAP B1 Technical Consultant to join our team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in SAP B1, with expertise in technical aspects, including the development and management of Crystal Reports, SQL queries, and database management using SQL Server and HANA DB. As an SAP B1 Technical Consultant, you will be responsible for analyzing business requirements and translating them into technical specifications. You will work closely with clients to understand their needs and provide solutions that enhance their SAP B1 systems. Your role will involve developing and customizing reports, optimizing database performance, and ensuring data integrity across various platforms. Key responsibilities include: - Collaborating with stakeholders to gather and analyze requirements for SAP B1 implementations. - Designing and developing Crystal Reports to meet business reporting needs. - Writing and optimizing SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation. - Managing and maintaining SQL Server and HANA DB environments to ensure optimal performance. - Providing technical support and troubleshooting for SAP B1 applications. - Staying updated with the latest SAP B1 features and best practices to enhance system functionality. The successful candidate will possess strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team. Proficiency in SAP B1 technical aspects, Crystal Reports, SQL queries, SQL Server, and HANA DB is essential. If you are passionate about leveraging technology to drive business success, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Sap Basis
description:
**Company Description**
Inensy Electronics Private Limited is a growing technology-driven organization focused on delivering reliable electronic solutions and services. The company emphasizes quality, innovation, and customer-centricity in all its operations. Team members collaborate across functions to support industry-standard practices and modern technologies. Inensy offers opportunities for skill development, professional growth, and participation in challenging projects. The work environment encourages accountability, continuous learning, and respect for diverse perspectives.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site SAP Basis role located in Vasai. The SAP Basis professional will be responsible for day-to-day system administration, including installation, configuration, monitoring, and maintenance of SAP environments. The role involves managing system performance, performing backups and restores, applying patches and upgrades, and ensuring high availability and security of SAP systems. The individual will troubleshoot technical issues, coordinate with functional and technical teams, and support end users with system-related queries. The role also includes working with database administrators, participating in projects and system migrations, and documenting procedures and best practices.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Basis Administration and SAP Basis skills for managing and maintaining SAP systems.
* Candidates should possess solid Troubleshooting skills to identify, analyze, and resolve system and performance issues.
* Candidates should possess Consulting abilities to collaborate with stakeholders, understand requirements, and recommend technical solutions.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of Databases and related tools to support SAP system operations and performance optimization.
* Relevant experience with SAP system installs, upgrades, patches, and transports.
* Understanding of operating systems (such as Linux/Unix/Windows) and networking fundamentals.
* Ability to document technical procedures and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in an SAP Basis role or similar system administration position is preferred.
